title: Qwen3-VL PyTorch FP16 baseline benchmark protocol freeze

model.reason_for_eager: Phase 9.1-A found the installed NVIDIA PyTorch SDPA API does not accept Transformers' enable_gqa argument

workload.image_description: deterministic white background with a filled red square at [112,112,335,335]
workload.eos_masking: EOS is masked before argmax for decode steps 0 through 14 to fix the decode workload at 16 tokens

timing_boundaries.preprocess_latency: host monotonic wall clock from chat-template plus processor call through CUDA transfer, pixel-values dtype cast, and torch.cuda.synchronize
timing_boundaries.vision_encoder_latency: CUDA event duration around model.visual forward minus the measured projector module durations; includes patch embedding, positional/RoPE preparation, and all 24 visual blocks
timing_boundaries.projector_latency: sum of CUDA event durations around visual.merger and the three visual.deepstack_merger_list modules
timing_boundaries.prefill_latency: CUDA event duration around the complete model.forward call on the full preprocessed image-plus-text input with logits_to_keep=1
timing_boundaries.decode_latency: host monotonic wall clock around the 15 subsequent cached decode calls after torch.cuda.synchronize; the first token is generated by the prefill forward
timing_boundaries.tokens_per_second: end-to-end generated tokens divided by the sum of prefill latency and subsequent decode latency
timing_boundaries.event_synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize before and after each timed region; CUDA events are synchronized before elapsed_time reads

power.scope: board input power VDD_IN plus VDD_CPU_GPU_CV and VDD_SOC rails
power.measurement_window: started after model load and before warmup; stopped after the final measured trial

memory.note: allocator snapshots are not a DRAM counter or a profiler peak

next_action: Run the frozen protocol exactly once, then stop and await Gate review
